text:
Type: large sunset seascape canvas print
Use: wall decoration; living room, bedroom, dining room, above a sofa or bed
Style: coastal, contemporary, modern
Materials: gallery-wrapped canvas, brushed watercolor-like photographic print
Colors: soft pale blue, deep navy, warm orange, lavender, white
Shape: wide horizontal rectangle, frameless, low horizon with flying seagulls and reflections, oversized but airy
Feel: serene, dreamy, calm, spacious
Goes with: white or soft blue walls, light wood, linen, navy accents; coastal or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Seagulls Across The Water Sunset Horizon Canvas Print Wall Art, 45" x 30"
product.description: After a long day, this tranquil print will help you relax. Birds sweep through a sunset horizon with all the blues, purples and oranges you remember from vacations with friends and family. This natural scene will blend with any existing style. A contemporary print of a classic, timeless scene Hand-stretched canvas on wood. Ready to hang with hardware included. 45" x 30" Made to order
